expectations.evidence: api-http.service.ts handleError() checks error.status === 0 (network) vs 401 vs other, typed as HttpErrorResponse
withRetryAndErrorHandling() uses retry({ count: 2, delay }) that returns timer on status 503 and rethrows otherwise
app.config.ts: provideBrowserGlobalErrorListeners() is the first provider
No interceptor file exists. Retry logic is embedded directly in ApiHttpService.withRetryAndErrorHandling() rather than a functional HttpInterceptorFn
ApiHttpService, GlobalErrorHandler all use inject() — no constructor injection

api-http.service.spec.ts uses vi.spyOn on the real ToastService instead of providing a mock, and some tests use done() callback pattern with Jasmine-style async — not a clean Vitest pattern. global-error-handler.spec.ts uses vi without importing it (relies on global), and tests call vi.spyOn without prior import. However provideHttpClient() + provideHttpClientTesting() ordering is correct. The bigger failure: api-http.service.spec.ts references `vi` without any import at the top of the file (line 62: `const toastSpy = vi.spyOn`), which is a runtime error.
